doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Sam Morgan, Jack Carey and Buddy Petit bands
summary: Burns recalls rival bands at a club and who played trumpet with Carey and Petit.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What's the name of the band that used to play at the ghost club next to Buddy Pee, you know they used to play a game two times? At the ghost club, they used to have a big thing in there.
Oh, Jack Herring. Who was playing trumpet with Jack Herring? You remember? What is he?
No, no, that was- Jack had his own band and Buddy had his own band. I know, but they played against him. You mean they used to buck against him.
Yeah, but Jack played trombone and who played trumpet?
Who played trumpet- let's see, well his brother played- He played trumpet with him.

He had a different trumpet player sometime, but Mutt was his- Not Kid Punch? Mutt Carey. Punch played with him sometime too. Oh yeah. Sure Kid Punch played with him sometime. Yeah, that's right. And do you remember who played in P.T.'s band at that time? Who? Buddy P.T.'s band?
Buddy P.T. Well, let's see, Chester and who played trombone? Oh, Jim Robinson played too, Sir Williamson and George. And who? George.
